title: Complete Vol B
summary: Since I began the day listening to Commander Cody and Guy Clark thought it important to go back to the beginning of Texas Blues with Blind Lemon Jefferson. Jefferson's guitar sound and Muddy Waters stop-time rhythm would become the backbone of Rock-n-Roll
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jn4AR_d3ykA

Since I began the day listening to Commander Cody and Guy Clark thought it important to go back to the beginning of Texas Blues with Blind Lemon Jefferson.

Jefferson's guitar sound and Muddy Waters stop-time rhythm would become the backbone of Rock-n-Roll
